FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Chand Rent a Car in Lahore FAQs

Answers to common car rental questions before you book.

What types of cars are available for rent in Lahore?
Chand Rent A Car offers luxury SUVs, sedans, executive vehicles, practical cars, pickup vehicles and group transportation options. Availability depends on the requested date and vehicle.
Do you offer chauffeur-driven cars in Lahore?
Yes. Chauffeur service is available for selected vehicles and can be used for airport transfers, business travel, weddings, city travel and other journeys.
Is self-drive car rental available?
Self-drive rental is available for selected vehicles, subject to availability and applicable booking requirements.
Do you provide Lahore Airport transfer?
Yes. Chand Rent A Car provides airport pickup and drop-off options for customers travelling through Lahore Airport.
Can I rent a car daily or monthly in Lahore?
Yes. Daily and monthly rental options are available. Contact the booking team with your preferred vehicle and rental duration for current availability and pricing.
How can I book a car from Chand Rent A Car?
Call or WhatsApp Chand Rent A Car at +92 300 0035 217. You can also use the quick booking form at the top of this page.
Are the rates shown on the website final?
The rates shown on this page are estimated daily rental ranges. Final pricing can vary according to vehicle, availability, booking date and rental requirements. Please confirm the final rate before booking.
